info.name: Registration API - majdpay (dev)
info.description:
Business-portal Merchant registration flow of emi-profile-service, plus the public lookup endpoints it depends on.

Built from BusinessTestCases/Registration/api/RegistrationAPIFlow.spec.ts (the 22-endpoint happy-path + negative + lookup suite) and RegistrationSessionRefresh.spec.ts (EMI-5995 / EMI-6059 session-refresh mechanism).

Base URL: https://gateway-dev.majdpay.com

Run folders 1-6 in order for one full registration E2E pass (mobile OTP -> verify -> identity -> file uploads -> submit -> NAFATH -> products -> contract). Folder 6 (Session Refresh) can be run at any point after folder 1's OTP verify to swap the session token; folders 7-8 (Lookups, Negative/Auth) are independent and can run any time.

{{otp}} defaults to '918512' — dev and UAT both accept a fixed all-zero OTP for any mobile (see RegistrationHelper.getOtpFromDb), so no IMAP/mailbox access is needed to run this by hand.

{{unifiedNumber}} / {{nationalId}} default to one entry from data/registrationAssets.json (uatOtpAssets) that is marked unused as of this writing. A 409/duplicate on request 5 just means it has since been consumed by a Playwright run — swap in a fresh entry from that file.

request.description:
EMI-5751: no Authorization header here by design — this endpoint must keep working without a session token (see '11. mobile/otp works without a token' below).

The pre-request script on this folder's first request refreshes {{mobileNumber}} to a fresh KSA number so repeat runs do not collide.

If otpRequired is false, the response already carries sessionToken/refreshToken (EMI-5995/EMI-6059) — the test script below stores them so step 4 can be skipped.

exec: // A fresh KSA-shaped mobile per run so repeat runs don't collide on an already-registered number.
if (b.otpRequired) { pm.test('requestId present when OTP is required', () => pm.expect(b).to.have.property('requestId')); }

request.description: Public — no token. Returns the OTP length/validity/resend-cooldown this environment enforces.
Only meaningful when otpRequired was true on request 1 — otherwise this environment has OTP disabled and resend is not applicable.

Skip this request if request 1 already returned otpRequired: false (dev/UAT both accept a fixed OTP — {{otp}} defaults to '918512', same value RegistrationHelper.getOtpFromDb() uses for ENV=dev|uat.

EMI-5995/EMI-6059: response now carries sessionToken AND refreshToken, each as { token, expirationDuration } (milliseconds).

Identity-establishing step. 201 on a fresh identity.

A 409 (or a 400 whose body mentions "already registered"/"duplicate") means {{unifiedNumber}} was already registered by a previous run against the shared UAT fixture pool — that is expected, not a bug (see RegistrationAPIFlow.spec.ts API-05). Pick a fresh, unused entry from data/registrationAssets.json (uatOtpAssets) and re-run from request 1 if you need a clean E2E pass.

exec: pm.test('201 on a fresh identity, or a documented already-registered response', () => {
if (alreadyRegistered) { console.warn('unifiedNumber already registered — pick a fresh asset from data/registrationAssets.json'); }

request.description: Attach any small image/PDF in Postman's file picker (the 'file' form field) before sending — Postman cannot embed a file inline in a committed collection. Playwright's equivalent (RegistrationAPIFlow.spec.ts API-06) uses a 1x1 PNG from data/registrationDefaults.json (testFileBase64).

Full sign-up submission. Stores profileCode (when returned) for the Contract folder.
Returns a redirect URI to the NAFATH app/web flow. NAFATH itself is not automatable — this only checks the URI is issued.

productIds is sent as a Postman string variable here — {{pickedProductId}} — Postman does not template a raw-body value into a JSON number, so this arrives as a numeric string; the API accepts it either way. Playwright sends a real number.
profileCode falls back to {{unifiedNumber}} if step 8 did not return one — set it manually if both are empty.
Completes registration. Per EMI-122, this only creates a "Pending Manual KYB" profile — no wallet/login credentials are issued until an admin reviews it (see the Negative folder's last-mile check).

EMI-5995 (BE) / EMI-6059 (FE Web). The refresh token travels as a HEADER named 'refreshToken', not a body field — confirm this collection still matches the live contract if it starts failing.

Continues the SAME registration session (no restart): run this any time after request 4 to swap in a fresh sessionToken before it expires, then keep going from wherever you left off in Business Info / NAFATH / Products / Contract.

item.name: 12. POST mobile OTP works WITHOUT a token (control)

request.description: EMI-5751 negative-control: this OTP-stage endpoint must itself NOT start requiring auth.

item.name: 13. POST session refresh - invalid refresh token (4xx)
14. POST session refresh - refresh token in body, not header (should not be 200)

request.description: EMI-6059 is explicit that refreshToken is a HEADER. If this starts returning 200, the contract has quietly widened to also accept it in the body.

exec: pm.test('body-only refresh token is NOT accepted', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.eql(200));

item.name: 15. The just-registered account cannot sign in yet (Pending Manual KYB)

request.description: EMI-122: contract/accept only creates a "Pending Manual KYB" profile. A wallet, Company Number and login credentials are issued only after an admin reviews and activates the account (separate Admin Portal flow, out of scope here).
